Messages.Body:
Can I put two Aching Beauty on the same Vampire?

E-mail answers wanted, thanks in advance!!

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Yes, multiple copies of Aching Beauty can be stacked on the same vampire,
and yes, the effect will be cumulative.
